credit_mode.description: Credit mode used for this order. 'legacy' = EUR-based credits (variable pricing per format), 'shipment' = 1 credit per shipment (flat rate). Auto-detected based on account configuration.

credits_used.description: Credits charged. For legacy mode: EUR amount. For shipment mode: number of shipment credits (1 per letter).

OrderItem.description: Either recipient_id OR recipient object is required. If recipient object is provided, the system will automatically check for duplicates and reuse existing contacts.

qr_code_id.description: ID of an existing QR code to link to this order item (create QR codes first via POST /v1/qr/codes)

recipient.description: Recipient address (alternative to recipient_id). System auto-deduplicates by matching first_name, last_name, street, zip, city.

recipient_id.description: ID of an existing recipient (alternative to providing recipient object)

sender_id.description: ID of an existing sender (create senders first via POST /v1/senders)

QrCodeCreate.description: Erstellt einen individuellen QR-Code. Jeder QR-Code erhält eine eindeutige URL. Ideal für personalisierte Sendungen, bei denen jeder Empfänger einen eigenen QR-Code bekommt.

campaign_id.description: ID der QR-Kampagne (erforderlich). Kampagnen können über POST /v1/qr/campaigns erstellt werden.

name.description: Optionaler Name für diesen QR-Code (nützlich zur internen Referenzierung)

target_url.description: Ziel-URL, zu der der QR-Code weiterleitet (erforderlich)

RecipientFull.description: Complete recipient object with all fields

svg_path_data.description: SVG path data for the handwritten signature

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key with ks_live_ or ks_test_ prefix
ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key

get.description: Listet alle eigenen Beilagen (Broschüren, Flyer etc.) auf. Beilagen müssen vorab im Dashboard angelegt werden. Die ID kann beim Erstellen einer Bestellung als customer_insert_id übergeben werden.

post.description: Searches for a German company by name, website domain, or email address and returns official address data, management (CEO/directors), and contact information from the German trade register (Handelsregister). Ideal for CRM enrichment workflows.

company_name.description: Company name to search for (highest priority)

email.description: Email address - domain will be extracted for search

200.description: Company data found or not found

post.description: Creates a single letter order. Multiple API calls can be combined into one order if made on the same day with the same format/envelope/QR configuration.

customer_insert_id.description: ID einer eigenen Beilage (Broschüre, Flyer etc.). Muss vorab im Dashboard angelegt und mit Lagerbestand versehen sein. Siehe GET /v1/customer-inserts.

envelope_template_id.description: ID einer Umschlag-Vorlage (siehe GET /v1/templates/envelopes). Optional -- wenn nicht angegeben, wird der Standard-Umschlag verwendet.

qr_code_id.description: ID of an existing QR code to link

recipient_id.description: ID of an existing recipient (alternative to recipient object)

template_id.description: ID of the template to use

post.description: Erstellt einen individuellen QR-Code. Jeder QR-Code erhält eine eindeutige URL. Ideal für personalisierte Sendungen, bei denen jeder Empfänger einen eigenen QR-Code bekommt.

get.description: List all recipients with optional search. Supports pagination.

parameters.description: Search in first_name, last_name, company_name, email
parameters.name: search

post.description: Create a new recipient. If a recipient with matching address (first_name, last_name, street, zip, city) already exists, returns the existing recipient with _reused: true.

delete.description: Delete a recipient. Will fail if recipient is used in any orders.

409.description: Conflict - recipient is used in orders

get.description: Returns the current shipment credit balance. Each credit equals one letter (card + envelope).

shipment_credits.description: Number of available shipment credits (1 credit = 1 letter)

delete.description: Deactivates the signature and permanently deletes all its variations
